intro: Upmods N’Chant is made for those who seek rest with depth. A bold blend of engraved textures, calming tones, and storage that keeps your life’s clutter quietly tucked away.

features.title: Lines etched with intention
features.text: The engraved headboard adds a layer of texture and quiet artistry to your space — a design detail that catches the eye without ever raising its voice.

features.title: A frame that stays grounded
features.text: Built from engineered wood, the structure is made to last through everyday use — offering unwavering strength without noise, shake, or shift.

features.title: Storage that lifts your load
features.text: Lift-up box storage opens smoothly to reveal spacious compartments below, making room for everything from blankets to seasonal clothes — all out of sight. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Tones that gently contrast
features.text: The dual-tone matte finish combines muted hues in a soft, modern balance — offering visual interest that enhances without overwhelming the room.

features.title: Surfaces that stay serene
features.text: An anti-scratch PU coating helps your bed stay beautiful through everyday wear, resisting scuffs so your space always feels clean and cared for.

name: Upmods N Chant King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
